_note: Per-channel defaults for studio.py. Content keys are top level; everything about how it LOOKS goes under 'style'. Command-line flags still override.
_writer: 'claude' calls the Anthropic API (pip install anthropic, plus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or `ant auth login`). 'ollama' uses a model on this machine -- run 'python studio.py --list-writer-models' for what is installed and what fits a 24GB card. Either way every caption, commentary line and description is written fresh per run; there are no built-in phrases.
_style: size_div divides the SHORT edge of the frame, so one setting renders the same size in both outputs and a bigger number means smaller text. case: sentence|upper|lower|none. Depth is border + shadow; box draws a solid plate instead and is off. Anything here can also be overridden per caption in a staged overlays.json.
_fonts: Press Start 2P is fixed-cell at about one em per character, so caption LENGTH decides the rendered size more than size_div does. Captions wrap to three lines, so keep them under about 70 characters. Run list_fonts.py to see every installed face drawn with your own text.
